assertions.title: Tailwind CSS replaces globals.css without layout regression

steps.action: Open / at 1280x800 and inspect the landing layout.
steps.expected: Hero, cards, spacing, typography, and CTA alignment render without desktop regression.
steps.observed: The hero, signed-out CTA row, capability cards, and section spacing rendered cleanly with no visible overlap or broken styling.

steps.action: Open /get-started at 1280x800 and inspect the dashboard shell.
steps.expected: Sidebar, topbar, quick actions, guide cards, and form panels render with consistent spacing and alignment.
steps.observed: The dashboard rendered with a stable sidebar, top status chips, quick actions, and aligned form panels with no obvious layout regression.

assertions.title: Responsive design works at mobile and tablet breakpoints

steps.expected: Dashboard adapts to tablet layout, exposes a sidebar toggle, and avoids horizontal overflow.
steps.observed: The tablet dashboard showed the toggle sidebar control, stacked quick actions cleanly, and reported scrollWidth 768 at innerWidth 768.

steps.expected: Landing and auth surfaces remain usable on mobile with no clipping, overlap, or horizontal overflow.
steps.observed: The landing page and sign-in card stayed readable and tappable at mobile width, and both reported scrollWidth 375 at innerWidth 375.

steps.expected: Dashboard controls collapse into a mobile-friendly single-column layout without overflow.
steps.observed: The dashboard stacked into a narrow-screen layout with the sidebar toggle still available and no horizontal overflow.

evidence.network: DOM checks reported no horizontal overflow at the tested 768px and 375px breakpoints.

assertions.title: Landing page renders and adapts to auth state

steps.expected: The landing page shows the hero, capability sections, flow content, and a signed-out primary CTA to /sign-up.
steps.observed: The signed-out landing page loaded and showed the primary CTA text "Sign Up & Start Building" linking to /sign-up.

steps.action: Attempt to complete auth and revisit / in a signed-in state.
steps.expected: The primary CTA changes to "Open Dashboard" and the signed-in state resolves successfully.
steps.observed: The signed-in state could not be reached because every auth mutation failed after the initial 202 response with a service_unavailable grain-activation error.

evidence.network: GET /api/v1/auth/me -> 401 while signed out; signed-in landing state blocked by failed auth operations.

assertions.issues: Blocked by backend auth failure: auth grain activation failed with "node runtime dependency 'janus-node-runtime' not found in injected dependencies".

assertions.title: Sign-in flow completes successfully

steps.action: Open /sign-in and enter the isolated test email.
steps.expected: Continue enables and reveals the password step.
steps.observed: The two-step form worked locally: Continue enabled for a valid email and revealed the password field.

steps.expected: Forgot your password? and Email sign-in code links navigate with the email query parameter.
steps.observed: Both links resolved correctly to /reset-password?email=... and /magic-code?email=....

steps.expected: The browser redirects to /get-started.
steps.observed: POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password returned 202, but the polled operation failed with service_unavailable and the UI stayed on /sign-in showing the grain activation error inline.

assertions.issues: Blocked by backend auth failure: sign-in never reached redirect because the auth grain could not activate.

assertions.title: Sign-up flow completes successfully

steps.action: Open /sign-up and enter the isolated test email.
steps.expected: Continue enables and reveals the password step.
steps.observed: The valid email enabled Continue and revealed the password step.

steps.action: Enter a short password, then a valid password.
steps.expected: The short password keeps Create account disabled, while the valid password enables submission.
steps.observed: "short" kept Create account disabled, and [redacted test password] enabled submission.

steps.action: Submit the form and inspect the alternate auth link.
steps.expected: Successful sign-up redirects to /get-started, and the Sign in link navigates back to /sign-in.
steps.observed: The Sign in link worked, but the signup request returned 202 and then failed during operation polling with service_unavailable, leaving the page on /sign-up with the grain activation error inline.

assertions.issues: Blocked by backend auth failure: sign-up never reached redirect because the auth grain could not activate.

assertions.title: Magic-code (passwordless) flow works end-to-end

steps.expected: The email is prefilled, the code request auto-submits, and six OTP inputs appear.
steps.observed: The email was prefilled and the page rendered six OTP inputs immediately after the request attempt.

steps.expected: Typing advances focus, ArrowLeft moves back, and Backspace navigates within the OTP fields.
steps.observed: Typing in digit 1 moved focus to digit 2, ArrowLeft moved focus back to digit 1, and invalid-code entry later reset the OTP inputs.

steps.expected: Verification auto-submits and shows an inline invalid-code error.
steps.observed: Entering 123456 produced the inline message "Invalid one-time code" and cleared the OTP fields.

steps.action: Attempt the full passwordless happy path.
steps.expected: A valid code verification redirects to /get-started and resend works.
steps.observed: The initial magic-code request operation failed with service_unavailable, so the end-to-end success path could not be completed or validated.

evidence.network: POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/request -> 202; GET /api/v1/operations/op_284d0ec0be48264351446764 -> failed (service_unavailable); entering 6 digits triggered POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/verify and produced an inline invalid-code state.

assertions.issues: Blocked by backend auth failure: the magic-code request operation failed before the success redirect path could be validated.

assertions.title: Reset-password flow works

steps.expected: The email field is prefilled.
steps.observed: The route prefilled the encoded test email correctly.

steps.action: Use the Back to sign-in link.
steps.expected: Navigation returns to /sign-in.
steps.observed: The Back to sign-in link navigated correctly to /sign-in.

steps.expected: The page shows either the reset-instructions success flash or a normal inline error state.
steps.observed: POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password/request returned 202, but the polled operation failed with service_unavailable and the UI showed the grain activation error inline.

assertions.issues: Blocked by backend auth failure: reset-password never reached a normal success outcome because the auth grain could not activate.

steps.expected: A user-friendly 404 page renders with recovery navigation back to the dashboard.
steps.observed: The app rendered a branded 404 page with the message "Page Not Found" and a "Back to Dashboard" link.

steps.expected: The link navigates back to the dashboard surface.
steps.observed: The recovery link navigated successfully to /janus.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed beyond the expected 404 response for the unknown route
evidence.network: GET /nonexistent-auth-surface-rerun -> 404 page rendered; recovery link navigated to /janus.

frictions.description: The auth pages surfaced a backend grain-activation error inline after the initial 202 response, so I had to poll the returned /api/v1/operations/* URLs directly to confirm whether the blocker was in the UI or the backend auth workflow.
frictions.resolution: Polled the signup, signin, magic-code request, and reset-password operation records with curl.exe and confirmed the same failed/service_unavailable backend error for each flow.

blockers.description: All tested auth mutations failed after their initial 202 response because auth grain activation could not resolve the injected dependency "janus-node-runtime".
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried each browser flow on the local source-built frontend, then polled the resulting operation records directly from http://localhost:8080; signup, signin, magic-code request, and reset-password request all still ended in failed/service_unavailable with the same missing dependency message.

summary: Tested 8 assertions: 3 passed (VAL-FH-004, VAL-FH-005, VAL-FH-028) and 5 were blocked by the current-source backend auth grain dependency failure (VAL-FH-006 through VAL-FH-010).
